_about: Where the downloaded sound library comes from (lane B4 part 2). tools/audio/fetch_library.py reads this, downloads into ~/Forge/shared/sound_library/<source>/ and writes library.json there (one entry per file: id, title, tags, licence, path, seconds). Adding a source or a category is one line here. Licences: Kenney packs and OpenGameArt items (searched with the CC0 filter, and each page checked for CC0) are CC0; BigSoundBank items (each page checked for its CC0 line) are CC0; Mixkit sound effects are under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (use in games, no attribution, but not redistributed as loose files).
